<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<meta name="description" content="Verraleaf Bagasse Tableware — Digital Visiting Card, Powered by Dhananjay Eximporter">
<meta name="theme-color" content="#0b4d2c">
<title>Verraleaf | Bagasse Tableware — Digital Visiting Card</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Poppins:wght@600;700;800&family=Inter:wght@400;500;600;700&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
  :root{
    --forest:#0b4d2c;
    --forest-dark:#073a20;
    --leaf:#8bcf22;
    --leaf-dark:#6ea815;
    --cream:#faf6ec;
    --paper:#ffffff;
    --ink:#173a28;
    --muted:#5c7268;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html{-webkit-text-size-adjust:100%}
  body{
    margin:0;
    min-height:100vh;
    background:
      radial-gradient(1200px 600px at 50% -10%, #eaf6da 0%, var(--cream) 55%);
    font-family:'Inter',Arial,sans-serif;
    color:var(--ink);
    padding:28px 14px 48px;
  }
  .wrap{max-width:460px;margin:0 auto}

  /* Header hint so anyone immediately knows what to do */
  .hint{
    text-align:center;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-size:13px;
    font-weight:600;
    letter-spacing:.06em;
    text-transform:uppercase;
    color:var(--forest);
    opacity:.75;
    margin:0 0 14px;
  }

  .card{
    background:var(--paper);
    border-radius:28px;
    overflow:hidden;
    box-shadow:0 18px 50px rgba(11,77,44,.18), 0 2px 8px rgba(11,77,44,.08);
    border:1px solid #e7ead6;
  }

  .hero{
    background:
      linear-gradient(180deg, var(--forest) 0%, var(--forest-dark) 100%);
    padding:34px 20px 28px;
    text-align:center;
    position:relative;
    overflow:hidden;
  }
  .hero::before{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; inset:0;
    background:
      radial-gradient(320px 200px at 20% 0%, rgba(139,207,34,.18), transparent 60%),
      radial-gradient(280px 200px at 90% 100%, rgba(139,207,34,.12), transparent 60%);
    pointer-events:none;
  }
  .logo-ring{
    width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;
    margin:0 auto 16px;
    background:radial-gradient(circle at 35% 30%, #ffffff 0%, #eef9df 55%, #d9efb3 100%);
    display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(139,207,34,.18), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);
    animation:breathe 3.2s ease-in-out infinite;
    position:relative;
    z-index:1;
  }
  .logo-ring img{width:78%;height:78%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
  @keyframes breathe{
    0%,100%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 6px rgba(139,207,34,.18), 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.35);}
    50%{ box-shadow:0 0 0 12px rgba(139,207,34,.08), 0 10px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.4);}
  }
  .brand{
    font-family:'Poppins',sans-serif;
    font-weight:800;
    font-size:30px;
    color:#fff;
    margin:2px 0 4px;
    letter-spacing:.01em;
    position:relative; z-index:1;
  }
  .tagline{
    color:#cfe8bd;
    font-size:14.5px;
    font-weight:500;
    max-width:320px;
    margin:0 auto;
    line-height:1.5;
    position:relative; z-index:1;
  }
  .powered{
    margin-top:14px;
    font-size:11.5px;
    color:#9fc98a;
    letter-spacing:.04em;
    position:relative; z-index:1;
  }

  .cta-hint{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:13.5px;
    font-weight:600;
    color:var(--forest);
    background:#eef7e2;
    padding:10px 14px;
    margin:16px 16px 0;
    border-radius:12px;
  }

  .actions{
    padding:16px;
    display:grid;
    grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;
    gap:12px;
  }
  .btn{
    display:flex;
    flex-direction:column;
    align-items:center;
    justify-content:center;
    gap:6px;
    padding:18px 10px;
    border-radius:18px;
    text-decoration:none;
    font-family:'Inter',sans-serif;
    font-weight:700;
    font-size:14.5px;
    text-align:center;
    border:none;
    cursor:pointer;
    transition:transform .15s ease, filter .15s ease, box-shadow .15s ease;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent;
  }
  .btn:active{transform:scale(.96)}
  .btn .ic{font-size:26px; line-height:1}

  .btn-primary{
    background:linear-gradient(180deg,#9de62c,var(--leaf));
    color:#0e3a1a;
    box-shadow:0 8px 18px rgba(139,207,34,.35);
    grid-column:1 / -1;
    flex-direction:row;
    padding:18px 16px;
    font-size:17px;
    position:relative;
  }
  .btn-primary .ic{font-size:24px}
  .btn-primary::after{
    content:"";
    position:absolute; inset:0; border-radius:18px;
    box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(139,207,34,.55);
    animation:pulse 2.4s ease-out infinite;
  }
  @keyframes pulse{
    0%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(139,207,34,.45)}
    70%{box-shadow:0 0 0 14px rgba(139,207,34,0)}
    100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 0 rgba(139,207,34,0)}
  }

  .btn-solid{ background:var(--forest); color:#fff; }
  .btn-outline{ background:#fff; color:var(--forest); border:2px solid #dfe8d3; }
  .btn-save{ background:#fff3d6; color:#7a5200; border:2px solid #f1dda3; grid-column:1 / -1; flex-direction:row; padding:16px; }
  .btn-save .ic{font-size:22px}

  .divider{height:1px;background:#eceee2;margin:6px 16px}

  .info{
    padding:20px 24px 26px;
    text-align:center;
    background:var(--cream);
  }
  .info-row{
    display:flex;
    align-items:flex-start;
    gap:10px;
    text-align:left;
    font-size:14.5px;
    color:var(--ink);
    line-height:1.5;
    margin:10px auto;
    max-width:340px;
  }
  .info-row .ic{font-size:18px; margin-top:1px}
  .info-row a{color:var(--forest); text-decoration:none; font-weight:600}
  .info-row b{color:var(--ink)}

  footer{
    text-align:center;
    font-size:12px;
    color:var(--muted);
    margin-top:16px;
  }

  /* entrance animation, orchestrated, respects reduced motion */
  .card, .hint, footer{ opacity:0; transform:translateY(14px); animation:rise .6s ease forwards; }
  .hint{animation-delay:.02s}
  .card{animation-delay:.1s}
  footer{animation-delay:.4s}
  @keyframes rise{ to{opacity:1; transform:translateY(0)} }

  @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce){
    *{animation:none !important; transition:none !important}
  }

  :focus-visible{ outline:3px solid #2f6fed; outline-offset:2px; }

  .toast{
    position:fixed; left:50%; bottom:24px; transform:translate(-50%,20px);
    background:#173a28; color:#fff; padding:12px 18px; border-radius:12px;
    font-size:14px; font-weight:600; opacity:0; pointer-events:none;
    transition:opacity .25s ease, transform .25s ease;
    box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.25);
    max-width:90vw; text-align:center; z-index:50;
  }
  .toast.show{opacity:1; transform:translate(-50%,0)}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div class="wrap">
  <p class="hint">👇 Tap any button below to connect</p>

  <div class="card">
    <div class="hero">
      <div class="logo-ring"><img src="data:image/png;base64," alt="Verraleaf leaf logo"></div>
      <div class="brand">Verraleaf</div>
      <div class="tagline">Eco-friendly bagasse tableware — plates, bowls, meal trays &amp; takeaway containers</div>
      <div class="powered">POWERED BY DHANANJAY EXIMPORTER</div>
    </div>

    <p class="cta-hint">Choose how you'd like to reach us 🌿</p>

    <div class="actions">
      <a class="btn btn-primary" href="https://wa.me/917391910075?text=Hello%20Verraleaf%2C%20I%20am%20interested%20in%20your%20bagasse%20tableware." target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="ic">💬</span> Chat on WhatsApp
      </a>

      <a class="btn btn-solid" href="tel:+917391910075">
        <span class="ic">📞</span> Call Now
      </a>
      <a class="btn btn-solid" href="mailto:Verraleafeco@gmail.com">
        <span class="ic">✉️</span> Send Email
      </a>

      <a class="btn btn-outline" href="https://www.dhananjayeximporters.com" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="ic">🌐</span> Visit Website
      </a>
      <a class="btn btn-outline" href="https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=Dhananjay+Paradise%2C+Sector+4%2C+Moshi+Pradhikaran%2C+PCMC%2C+Pune%2C+Maharashtra+412105" target="_blank" rel="noopener">
        <span class="ic">📍</span> Get Directions
      </a>

      <button class="btn btn-save" onclick="saveContact()">
        <span class="ic">📇</span> Save to Contacts
      </button>

      <button class="btn btn-outline" style="grid-column:1 / -1;flex-direction:row" onclick="shareCard(event)">
        <span class="ic">↗️</span> Share This Card
      </button>
    </div>

    <div class="divider"></div>

    <div class="info">
      <div class="info-row"><span class="ic">🏢</span><span><b>Verraleaf</b> — Powered by Dhananjay Eximporter</span></div>
      <div class="info-row"><span class="ic">📞</span><span><a href="tel:+917391910075">+91 73919 10075</a></span></div>
      <div class="info-row"><span class="ic">✉️</span><span><a href="mailto:Verraleafeco@gmail.com">Verraleafeco@gmail.com</a></span></div>
      <div class="info-row"><span class="ic">📍</span><span>Plot 158, 301, Dhananjay Paradise, Sector 4, Moshi Pradhikaran, PCMC, Pune – 412105, Maharashtra, India</span></div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <footer>Save this card, share it with anyone — it works like a digital business card.</footer>
</div>

<div class="toast" id="toast"></div>

<script>
function showToast(msg){
  const t=document.getElementById('toast');
  t.textContent=msg;
  t.classList.add('show');
  clearTimeout(window.__toastTimer);
  window.__toastTimer=setTimeout(()=>t.classList.remove('show'),2400);
}

async function shareCard(e){
  e.preventDefault();
  const data={title:'Verraleaf | Bagasse Tableware',text:'Verraleaf — Eco-friendly bagasse tableware, powered by Dhananjay Eximporter.',url:window.location.href};
  if(navigator.share){
    try{ await navigator.share(data); }catch(err){}
  } else {
    try{
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href);
      showToast('Link copied — you can now share it!');
    }catch(err){
      showToast('Copy this page\'s link to share it.');
    }
  }
}

function saveContact(){
  const vcard =
`BEGIN:VCARD
VERSION:3.0
N:;Verraleaf;;;
FN:Verraleaf - Dhananjay Eximporter
ORG:Dhananjay Eximporter
TITLE:Bagasse Tableware
TEL;TYPE=CELL:+917391910075
EMAIL:Verraleafeco@gmail.com
URL:https://www.dhananjayeximporters.com
ADR;TYPE=WORK:;;Plot 158, 301, Dhananjay Paradise, Sector 4, Moshi Pradhikaran, PCMC;Pune;Maharashtra;412105;India
NOTE:Eco-friendly bagasse tableware — plates, bowls, compartment plates, meal trays and takeaway containers.
END:VCARD`;
  const blob = new Blob([vcard], {type:'text/vcard'});
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  const a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = url;
  a.download = 'Verraleaf-Contact.vcf';
  document.body.appendChild(a);
  a.click();
  document.body.removeChild(a);
  URL.revokeObjectURL(url);
  showToast('Contact saved — check your Downloads!');
}
</script>
</body>
</html>
